conclusion.reason: The 4B model produced valid output, but consumed about 4.5-4.9 GiB RSS and showed unstable 6.0-29.5 second generation latency with substantial swap. It should not remain resident alongside OCR and embedding models without further measurement.

limitations: This is a two-run engineering gate, not a statistically sufficient latency benchmark.
Time-to-first-token and exact token throughput were not instrumented in this harness revision.
The second run followed other heavy build and inference activity, so its higher swap and latency must not be attributed to context size alone.
Airplane mode was not enforced during these two runs; the runtime itself used only a private local GGUF file.
